title: GCMagicc v1.0.1: model and evaluation code for "GCMagicc v1: a fast generative emulator for multivariate climate-impact ensembles"

creators.name: Meinshausen, Nicolai
creators.affiliation: The University of Melbourne; University of Washington

creators.name: Meinshausen, Malte
creators.affiliation: The University of Melbourne; Climate Resource

description:
Frozen code release of GCMagicc v1.0.1 accompanying the Geoscientific Model Development manuscript GCMagicc v1: a fast generative emulator for multivariate climate-impact ensembles (EGUsphere preprint egusphere-2026-5176).

The release contains the frozen model code for the GCMagicc and GCMagicc-CE configurations, the evaluation, drought-attribution, regional-scenario and figure workflows, compact prepared data, figures, provenance manifests, tests, and the ERA5 retrieval recipe (data/era5_retrieval/).

This is a mixed-licence release: code is licensed under Apache License 2.0; data, figures and documentation are licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (see LICENSE, LICENSES/ and .reuse/dep5).

The trained model checkpoints, reproduction bundles and validation databases are too large for this record and are archived separately at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22139683.
